name: KiWay Test Point Descriptor Extractor
description: Resolve test points through passives to IC pins and export engineering documentation.
description_full: Scans TP and TestPoint footprints, extracts descriptor/function fields, traces connected nets through common passives and NetTie_Path parts to terminal IC pins, parses board-sequence TM/TC labels, cross-selects results on the PCB, and exports CSV, Markdown, and HTML.
